title: Reduced primary street setback for a portion of the frontage: minimum reduced setback
text: C3.3.2 Notwithstanding C3.3.1, the following reductions are permitted: i. the primary street setback line may be reduced for a portion of the frontage width in accordance with in Table 3.3b (refer Figure 3.3a). Table 3.3b Reduced street setback, reduced primary street setback: R2 13m; R2.5 10m; R5 8m; R10 - R12.5 5m; R15 - R25 4m; R30 - R35 3m; R40 2m.

replaces.note: 50% compensated reduction replaced by fixed reduced setback
R30-R40 'up to 1 m for 30% of frontage' -> Table 3.3b

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Applies only where a portion is built forward (reduced-portion width > 0). No Table 3.3b row for R50+. Companion test C3.3.2(i)-r1 limits the width of the reduced portion. Draft typo 'in accordance with in Table 3.3b'.
